text.zh-CN: 抗生素能治疗细菌感染，不能清除引起病毒性脑膜炎的病毒；疱疹病毒等特定病因可能使用抗病毒药。
text.en: Antibiotics treat bacterial infection but do not clear the viruses causing viral meningitis; selected causes such as herpesviruses may be treated with antivirals.

supports.assessment: Antibiotic limitation and herpes antiviral treatment.
No general viral-specific treatment; selected herpes/influenza antiviral benefit.

text.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素是减轻炎症的辅助药，不替代抗生素。WHO建议在非流行期的适用急性细菌性病例中，与首剂抗生素一起开始；NICE对年龄和病原体另作规定，由医院决定，不能自行套用到所有脑膜炎。
text.en: Corticosteroids are adjuncts that reduce inflammation, not replacements for antibiotics. WHO recommends starting them with the first antibiotic dose in eligible acute bacterial cases outside epidemics; NICE adds age- and pathogen-specific rules. The hospital decides rather than applying steroids to every meningitis case.

supports.assessment: Non-epidemic setting; corticosteroid with first antibiotic.
Over-3-month use; specialist advice at 28 days–3 months; organism-specific continuation; never delay antibiotics.
Corticosteroid adjunct to antibiotics, reduction of inflammation/complications.

text.zh-CN: 抗生素偶可引起严重过敏。用药后出现呼吸困难、口唇舌头或喉咙肿胀，要立即呼叫急救；在医院内立即告知医护，不能等下一次常规复诊。
text.en: Antibiotics can occasionally cause severe allergy. Trouble breathing or swelling of the lips, tongue or throat after a dose requires emergency help immediately; in hospital alert staff at once, rather than waiting for routine follow-up.

supports.assessment: Antibiotics, airway symptoms and immediate emergency action.

text.zh-CN: 抗结核药需要留意不良反应：出现眼睛或皮肤发黄、视力改变等情况，联系治疗团队进行评估；医生据具体药物决定检查和是否调整治疗。
text.en: Anti-TB medicines need adverse-effect surveillance: yellowing of the eyes or skin, or changes in vision, should be reported to the treatment team for assessment; the specific drug determines tests and treatment changes.

supports.assessment: Jaundice and vision changes require reporting/evaluation; hepatic/ocular toxicities vary by drug.

text.zh-CN: 时间按适用指南核对：WHO对其急性社区获得性脑膜炎范围内的超过1月龄的儿童和成人，建议出院前正式听力筛查，不能完成时在出院后4周内完成；英国NICE针对细菌性脑膜炎或脑膜炎球菌病，建议身体状况允许测试后4周内完成，最好出院前。两个起算点不同。
text.en: Check the applicable timing: for children over 1 month and adults within its acute community-acquired meningitis scope, WHO recommends formal hearing screening before discharge, or within 4 weeks after discharge if that is not possible. UK NICE recommends assessment after bacterial meningitis or meningococcal disease within 4 weeks of being well enough for testing, preferably before discharge. These are different starting points.

text.en: WHO makes a strong recommendation for timely hearing screening despite very low certainty of evidence, relying mainly on indirect evidence and expert judgement; this does not mean the exact timing has been established by high-quality comparative trials.

text.zh-CN: 接种年龄、补种、旅行或暴发时的额外接种，应按所在地公共卫生部门安排核对。本页WHO的疫苗范围、英国NHS和美国CDC的建议各有适用背景，不能把某国接种时间直接用于其他国家。
text.en: Check local public-health schedules for routine ages, catch-up doses and additional travel or outbreak vaccination. WHO’s vaccine scope and UK NHS and US CDC advice have their own settings; one country’s timing should not be copied directly into another.

text.en: Close contacts of meningococcal disease may need preventive antibiotics and exposure assessment even if vaccinated; a clinician or public-health team determines who needs them.
